candidate_system_package_roles: git and ca-certificates for exact RR/source checkout
python3 for image receipt and G1 runner
C/C++ linker, libc development headers and pkg-config for locked Cargo crates
runtime loader libraries for pinned rustc and generated RR binaries
required_context: context/rr/ (clean Git checkout at exact RR commit, including .git)
context/debs.tar (exact .deb set and SHA256SUMS; package versions and apt snapshot frozen)
context/vendor.tar (Cargo registry vendor tree and .cargo-checksum.json files)
context/cargo-config.toml (source replacement to vendor; offline mode)
context/rustc-vv-expected.txt (full exact -Vv output from official archive)
IMAGE-INPUTS.json and write-image-receipt.py from the reviewed Cloud candidate Git object
commands_after_context_restore: docker build --network=none --file Dockerfile.candidate --build-arg DEB_BUNDLE_SHA256=<frozen> --build-arg VENDOR_TREE_SHA256=<frozen> --build-arg CARGO_CONFIG_SHA256=<frozen> --tag <immutable-candidate-tag> .
docker create <immutable-candidate-tag>; docker cp <local-container>:/opt/g1-image-receipt.json <evidence>/image-receipt.json; docker rm <local-container>
sha256sum <evidence>/image-receipt.json; verify receipt pins and package inventory against reviewed context
resolve pushed image to sha256 digest and save registry receipt binding digest, image-receipt SHA256, cold Build ID and context generation
record /opt/g1-executables.sha256, clean RR Git identity, rustc -Vv, Cargo lock hash, context inventory, package versions, timing and resource receipt

admission_rule: Missing/null identity, digest, context generation or checksum blocks the cold submit. Only a terminal reconciled cold Build can supply an immutable warm image digest.
